headlines.title_en: Goldman Sachs remains bullish on Japan's AI sector: post-selloff presents buying opportunity
headlines.summary_en: Goldman Sachs says the sharp sell-off in Japan's AI-related stocks has created a buying opportunity, and believes strong earnings prospects could revive investor interest in semiconductor stocks. Goldman's chief Japan equity strategist Bruce Kirk said the pullback lowers the bar for earnings to impress investors, putting many AI-related stocks at levels where earnings beats could have a greater impact on stock prices. He said: 'As long as you don't see a material deterioration in the geopolitical situation, current levels seem like a good time to add to certain positions. We don't think the AI story is over.' Kirk expects investor focus to return to fundamentals. 'Ultimately, it all comes down to earnings,' he said. 'At much lower levels than end-June, strong results should allow investors to refocus on the AI earnings story.' However, Kirk expects near-term volatility to remain.

Qiu Huiying, a human resources manager in Guangdong, worries in numerical terms when she looks ahead to the next decade: a 20-year mortgage, a 10 per cent loss on her property and thousands of yuan in monthly childcare costs that are set to rise.

headlines.title_en: Hot projects in future industries see valuations change 'weekly,' VCs pick winners amid rush
headlines.summary_en: 'Good projects are fiercely competitive, valuations are getting higher and higher!' 'Just a week later, valuations have gone up again.' Recently, future industries represented by AI large models and embodied intelligence are attracting continuous investment, with primary market investors busy searching for projects, worried about missing potential star projects. Qingke Research data shows: in the first half of 2026, the equity investment market completed 5,944 investment cases, up 14.7% year-on-year; investment amount was about 565.4 billion yuan, up 31.9% year-on-year. Market activity has returned to high levels. Industry sources say that since this year, the investment pace of venture capital institutions has accelerated significantly. Frontier hard tech is entering the technology implementation cycle, and the capital market continues to broaden the listing paths for sci-tech enterprises, with multiple forces jointly boosting primary market investment confidence. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 港股迎来解禁高峰
headlines.summary: 进入2026年下半年，港股市场迎来限售股解禁高峰期。多家机构测算，2026年港股全年解禁规模或接近2万亿港元，较2025年大幅增长，今年7月、9月和12月成为筹码集中释放的重要时点。不过，从历史经验及近期市场表现看，机构普遍认为，解禁不等同于减持，其影响更多集中于部分流通盘较小、解禁比例较高的个股，尚不足以对港股大盘构成系统性冲击。与此同时，南向资金在部分核心标的上仍展现出较强的定向承接力，多家上市公司的基石投资者、战略股东及管理层也主动延长锁定期或作出不减持承诺，凸显长期资金对优质港股资产的认可。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong stocks face a wave of lockup expirations
headlines.summary_en: Entering the second half of 2026, the Hong Kong stock market faces a peak period of lockup share expirations. Multiple institutions estimate that the total scale of H-share lockup expirations in 2026 could approach 2 trillion Hong Kong dollars, a significant increase from 2025, with July, September, and December being key months for concentrated share release. However, based on historical experience and recent market performance, institutions generally believe that lockup expirations do not equal减持 (reductions), and their impact is more concentrated on stocks with small public float and high lockup ratios, not enough to cause systemic shocks to the Hong Kong market. At the same time, southbound funds still show strong targeted absorption capacity in some core stocks, and cornerstone investors, strategic shareholders, and management of many listed companies have actively extended lockup periods or made no减持 (reduction) commitments, highlighting long-term capital's recognition of quality Hong Kong stock assets. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.title: 二季度券商客户投诉量环比增长22.3%
headlines.summary: 从业内获悉，中国证券业协会近日在行业内通报了2026年二季度证券公司投诉处理工作情况，给火热的市场提了醒：当二季度A股日均成交额冲上2.88万亿元、两融余额一度突破3万亿元大关之际，投资者诉求也同步“水涨船高”。数据显示，二季度全行业共接收客户投诉9610件，环比攀升22.3%；在投诉总量上行的背景下，办结率仍维持高位，当期累计办结8888件，办结率达92.5%。（中证报）

headlines.title_en: Brokerage customer complaints rise 22.3% QoQ in Q2
headlines.summary_en: Industry sources say the Securities Association of China recently circulated a report on the handling of securities company complaints in Q2 2026, serving as a warning for the hot market: as the average daily turnover of A-shares rose to 2.88 trillion yuan in Q2 and margin balances once broke through 3 trillion yuan, investor complaints also rose in tandem. Data shows the industry received 9,610 client complaints in Q2, up 22.3% quarter-on-quarter; amidst rising total complaints, the resolution rate remained high with 8,888 cases resolved, a rate of 92.5%. (China Securities Journal)

headlines.summary: 受益于超额收益稳定、资金持续涌入的影响，公募指数增强基金规模在二季度末首次突破3200亿元。同时，随着新品发行节奏的加快，指数增强基金的数量快速超过千只。在日益增加的竞争压力下，能否长期获得稳定的超额收益，成为各家基金公司比拼的核心。（上证报）

headlines.summary_en: Benefiting from stable excess returns and continued capital inflows, the scale of public fund index-enhanced funds exceeded 320 billion yuan for the first time at the end of Q2. At the same time, with the acceleration of new product issuance, the number of index-enhanced funds quickly surpassed 1,000. Under increasing competitive pressure, the ability to obtain stable excess returns over the long term has become the core competition for fund companies. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: AI算力需求催热上半年业绩，行业人士称MLCC产业链高景气度下半年将延续
headlines.summary: 今年以来，受益于AI算力需求爆发，素有“电子工业大米”之称的MLCC（片式多层陶瓷电容器）供应紧俏，价格持续上涨，带动被动元器件行业景气度回升，多家上市公司预计上半年业绩实现大幅增长，最高增幅超过6倍。展望下半年，有行业人士表示，7月以来，MLCC价格整体平稳，品类内部价格则分化加剧，AI和车规级高端高容产品价格继续上涨。在AI服务器需求旺盛、原厂产能被锁定、上游贵金属等原材料价格居高的背景下，预计下半年高端高容MLCC价格将继续上涨，并有望推高被动元器件市场整体景气度。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: AI computing demand boosts H1 earnings; MLCC supply chain's high景气 to continue in H2, say industry insiders
headlines.summary_en: Since the start of the year, driven by the explosion in AI computing demand, MLCCs (multi-layer ceramic capacitors), known as the 'rice of the electronics industry', have seen tight supply and rising prices, boosting the recovery of the passive components sector. Multiple listed companies expect a significant increase in H1 performance, with the highest increase exceeding 6 times. Looking ahead to H2, industry insiders say that since July, MLCC prices have been generally stable, but price divergence within categories has intensified, with prices for AI and automotive-grade high-end high-capacity products continuing to rise. Against the backdrop of strong AI server demand, locked-in production capacity at factories, and high prices for upstream precious metals and other raw materials, high-end high-capacity MLCC prices are expected to continue rising in H2, potentially boosting the overall sentiment of the passive components market. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 长鑫科技上市背后 产业新贵能否带火合肥楼市？
headlines.summary: 【长鑫科技上市背后 产业新贵能否带火合肥楼市？】从合肥市区出发，经长江西路进入机场高速，再从长兴大道出口驶出，不多远即可到达空港集成电路配套产业园。7月27日，园区里的国产存储龙头企业长鑫科技登陆科创板。上市当日，长鑫科技涨幅为465.82%，收于49元/股，总市值3.28万亿元，问鼎A股市值榜首。资本的造富效应，令当地房企率先抢占先机。早在今年6月，就有房地产项目向长鑫科技员工推出“定向团购”，园区附近的房产中介也加大了推介力度。

headlines.title_en: Changxin Technology listing: Can the new industry darling boost Hefei's property market?
headlines.summary_en: [Behind CXMT's listing: Can the new industry darling boost Hefei's property market?] Starting from Hefei city center, take Changjiang West Road to Airport Expressway, then exit at Changxing Avenue, and it's a short distance to the Airport Integrated Circuit Supporting Industrial Park. On July 27, domestic memory leader ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) debuted on the STAR Market. On its first day, CXMT surged 465.82% to close at 49 yuan per share, with a market cap of 3.28 trillion yuan, topping the A-share market cap chart. The wealth-creating effect of capital has prompted local property developers to seize the opportunity. As early as June this year, some real estate projects offered 'targeted group purchases' to CXMT employees, and nearby property agents have also stepped up their marketing.
